name: human_06_vacuum_topoff_typo_setpoint_marine
story: Marine tank, setpoint 25. Owner tops off with cold RO water, later the cleaner unplugs the controller while vacuuming (approximated with a reboot), then the owner types setpoint 20 instead of 25 and corrects it the next day. Sun on the tank in the afternoon adds heat.

events.note: Owner tops off with cold RO water straight from the tap/storage (15 L at 14 C)

Cleaner unplugs the controller while vacuuming and replugs it later. Approximation: real behaviour would be both NC relays resting and both loads ON via internal thermostats for the period; power_outage would wrongly cut all loads
Owner types 20 instead of 25; firmware clamps to the 20-30 range, so 20 is accepted
Next afternoon sun hits the tank
Owner notices the wrong setpoint and restores 25

expect: Cold top-off (about 0.5 K step on 300 L): all probes drop together and agree, so no fault; the rate stays below 0.05 C/s per probe, heater brings the tank back to 25 C without overshoot above 26 C and no chiller activation.

Reboot at 11 h: relays go to rest (both loads ON) during boot, control resumes quickly with a trusted reading; BUG if the heater is held off after reboot or fail-safe persists beyond the initial probe seeding window.

Setpoint 20 is legitimate for the firmware: heater stops, tank slowly cools toward ~20-22 C (UA 8 W/K, room 22) and the chiller might engage only if tank > 20 + coolDeadband; no alarm until <22.5 C when the undertemp alarm MUST fire (trusted reading). Fish should reach stress below 22.5 C only if it cools that far in ~24 h; report it.

Sun at 38 h with setpoint 20: chiller is active (tank above setpoint plus deadband) and must keep it from overshooting; with setpoint restored to 25 the heater resumes and the tank recovers to 25 C by the end. BUG if the heater and chiller are both on at once in normal operation, or setpoint changes are not clamped to 20..30.
